concept_types.label: Architecture Element

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: profile owner review plus discriminating fixture

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: An architecture element is not automatically a DomainSpec concept or source file.

concept_types.label: Domain Concept Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact binding fixture and profile owner review

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: Implementation shape does not establish DomainSpec identity, formation, or admission.

concept_types.label: Enum Implementation

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact reciprocal DS-D1.3 binding, owner-authored catalogue, selected native protocol, explicit wire boundary, and non-collapse fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A finite-looking constant set is not necessarily an admitted DomainSpec Enum, Value Object, or State Machine.

concept_types.label: Enum Representation Unit
concept_types.owner_route: Enum realization profile plus language adapter owner

challenge_contract.resolution_gate: exact member provenance plus acyclic composition fixtures

concept_types.forbidden_collapse: A representation unit is implementation evidence only; it is not a DomainSpec Enum, canonical value set, module, or source-file identity.

property_definitions.label: Canonical concept identifier
property_definitions.semantics: Exact owner-resolved DomainSpec concept identifier associated with the implementation.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: The ontology and folder layout cannot mint this identifier.

property_definitions.label: Binding freshness
property_definitions.semantics: Whether mapping, source, profile, and projection digests reconcile exactly.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A stale binding cannot be repaired by filename similarity.

property_definitions.label: Owner-authored Enum catalogue reference
property_definitions.semantics: Content-addressed owner input that fixes member identifiers, language-facing keys, and canonical wire values before implementation observation.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Generated or runtime members cannot author, widen, or replace the catalogue.

property_definitions.label: Owner-resolved expected Enum values
property_definitions.semantics: Closed named-value set supplied by the accountable canonical binding owner.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Expected values must never be inferred from the implementation value set.

property_definitions.label: Enum alias policy
property_definitions.semantics: Two member keys may not identify one canonical wire value.
property_definitions.observation_stage: descriptor binding plus native hostile fixture
property_definitions.owner_route: Enum realization profile plus language adapter owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A runtime that tolerates aliases does not make aliases portable or admitted.

property_definitions.label: Enum representation composition kind
property_definitions.semantics: Whether a representation owns leaf members directly or derives them through composed_from relations.
property_definitions.owner_route: Enum realization profile plus language adapter owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Composition shape does not change the portable closed value-set meaning.

property_definitions.label: Enum domain and wire equality collapse
property_definitions.semantics: A domain member and its raw wire string remain distinct values across the explicit adapter boundary.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Equal textual spelling does not make a raw wire string a domain member.

property_definitions.label: Enum equality and hash contract
property_definitions.semantics: Language-specific equality and hashing behavior selected without collapsing members into raw wire values.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Hashability or textual equality alone does not establish Enum identity.

property_definitions.label: Enum exhaustiveness requirement
property_definitions.semantics: The selected language protocol must account for every member of the closed owner catalogue.
property_definitions.owner_route: Enum language profile plus provider owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: One successful match or lookup cannot prove complete member coverage.

property_definitions.label: Implemented Enum member records
property_definitions.semantics: Code-facing key and canonical candidate value pairs observed only at direct representation leaves.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Member keys, declaration order, or source location do not establish canonical Enum meaning.

property_definitions.label: Implemented Enum values
property_definitions.semantics: Normalized named values observed for a direct unit or derived for a composed unit from total leaf-member fact inputs.
property_definitions.observation_stage: native type observation or composition derivation
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Observed implementation members cannot define the canonical expected set.

property_definitions.label: Enum native extension policy
property_definitions.semantics: Language inheritance, mutation, or runtime construction cannot add members after catalogue closure.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Language extension facilities cannot widen the owner-authored set.

property_definitions.label: Enum native realization form
property_definitions.semantics: Profile-selected language-native form used to represent the closed owner catalogue.
property_definitions.observation_stage: profile binding plus native type observation
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A native form does not define portable Enum membership or canonical wire values.

property_definitions.label: Enum wire emission totality
property_definitions.semantics: Every admitted member has exactly one explicit canonical wire output.
property_definitions.observation_stage: owner catalogue plus runtime round-trip fixtures
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: String conversion or serialization convention does not prove a total explicit adapter.

property_definitions.label: Enum wire parsing fallibility
property_definitions.semantics: Parsing an unknown wire value fails without constructing a member.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A successful known-value parse cannot prove unknown values fail.

property_definitions.label: Identity component count
property_definitions.semantics: Count of owner-resolved identity components exposed by the realization.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Implementation equality or naming does not establish DomainSpec identity.

property_definitions.label: Realization protocol identifier
property_definitions.semantics: Stable identifier of the profile-selected protocol used to realize and observe an architecture element.
property_definitions.owner_route: architecture profile owner plus language adapter owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A matching protocol identifier does not prove semantic identity, correct implementation, or runtime behavior.

property_definitions.label: Runtime provider digest
property_definitions.semantics: SHA-256 digest of the exact runtime provider bytes admitted by the selected architecture profile.
property_definitions.observation_stage: profile binding plus runtime provider hashing
property_definitions.owner_route: architecture profile owner plus runtime provider owner
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: Digest equality proves byte identity only; it does not prove domain meaning, conformance, safety, or production admission.

property_definitions.label: Declared transition count
property_definitions.semantics: Count of admitted state transitions carried by the realization.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A transition-shaped method cannot establish a DomainSpec State Machine.

property_definitions.label: Typed data field count
property_definitions.semantics: Count of value-bearing typed fields exposed by a realized domain concept.
property_definitions.forbidden_inference: A field count cannot establish Value Object identity or formation.

relation_definitions.owner_route: Enum realization profile plus language adapter owner
relation_definitions.forbidden_collapse: A composition edge records implementation provenance; it does not create canonical Enum membership, ownership, or authority.

language_projections.blocked_use: pretend Python visibility is TypeScript export privacy

language_projections.blocked_use: treat Cargo package edges as complete intra-crate source topology
